design_description: An elegant black and antique gold design inspired by the rich heritage of Mesopotamia. The front features intricate, symmetrical floral ornaments with flowing gold motifs, creating a regal and sophisticated appearance. The back incorporates traditional Mesopotamian geometric patterns, two majestic lions, palm trees and a stepped ziggurat, celebrating the region's ancient civilization. Gold shoulder stripes, collar detailing and bold player lettering complete the prestigious look of Lions of Mesopotamia.
